lines.text: Near Jericho, Joshua meets the Commander of the LORD's army and is told to take off his sandals.
The LORD tells Joshua to circle the city once a day for six days, then seven times on day seven.
The armed troops march ahead of the priests, the rear guard follows the ark, and the people must not shout.
On the seventh day they rise at noon, circle the city seven times, and Joshua commands a shout.
Joshua sends seven priests into Rahab's house, and they bring out her family and settle them outside the camp.
